crosssave.disclaimer.title: Beta Mod's Warning, Matey
crosssave.disclaimer.body: This mod be in beta. It may wreck yer saves, lose yer booty, or stir up trouble unforeseen. Ye sail these waters at yer own risk.
crosssave.disclaimer.button: Aye, I Know and Take the Risk
crosssave.disclaimer.config_failed: Couldn't stow yer agreement, matey. Check the config folder's permissions and try again.
crosssave.screen.title: Choose Yer Destination Save
crosssave.screen.hint: After the voyage, ye'll leave this save behind.
crosssave.screen.empty: No other saves on the chart, matey.
crosssave.screen.scroll: Scroll or use Page Up / Page Down: %s–%s / %s
crosssave.screen.save_failed: Couldn't stow the data. Try again or belay that.
crosssave.chat.saved: Data stowed! Leave this save yerself and sail into %s. Yer booty'll return on its own.
crosssave.chat.arrived: Land ho at %s! Spare booty lies at yer feet.
crosssave.chat.failed: The voyage failed. Back to yer original save.
crosssave.chat.usage: Orders: /crosssave save <destination save folder> or /crosssave load
crosssave.chat.invalid_folder: Give the destination save folder's name, not its whole course.
crosssave.chat.dismounted: Ye've stepped off yer mount. No creatures aboard this voyage.
crosssave.chat.save_failed: Couldn't stow the data. Ye're still in this save. Read the logbook and try again.
crosssave.chat.load_failed: Couldn't restore or clear the data. Read the logbook and try /crosssave load again.
crosssave.chat.operation_failed: The order failed. Read the logbook.
crosssave.chat.list_failed: Couldn't read the save chart. Read the logbook and try again.
crosssave.chat.uuid_mismatch: Yer UUID ain't the saved sailor's UUID
crosssave.chat.no_safe_position: Danger underfoot, and no safe berth nearby! Find safe ground yerself.
crosssave.chat.moved_to_safety: Danger underfoot! Ye've been hauled to safe ground.
crosssave.loading.title: Sailing Between Saves
crosssave.loading.subtitle: Don't close the game, matey
crosssave.chat.busy: The voyage be underway. Hold fast, matey.
crosssave.chat.manual_fallback: The automatic voyage ain't finished. Yer data be safe. Leave yerself and sail into %s. Yer booty'll return on its own.
crosssave.chat.rollback_failed: Couldn't sail back to yer original save on our own.
crosssave.settings.title: Ship's Settings
crosssave.settings.manual: Yer orders outrank the automatic lookout
crosssave.settings.save_failed: Couldn't stow the settings. Check the config folder's permissions.
crosssave.chat.transfer_cancelled: Voyage belayed. Yer original booty be back. Choose a destination anew.
crosssave.chat.pending_exists: A voyage be waiting. Enter its destination save to reclaim yer booty first.
crosssave.chat.nested_safe: Booty within booty spotted; a safe voyage has been enforced, matey.
